scenario.title: 週一早上：How was your weekend?
scenario.context: 週一進辦公室、語言交換見面，第一句話幾乎都是 How was your weekend?。這不是在要一份報告，而是給你一個輕鬆開聊的機會。答案用過去式、講一兩個細節，再把問題丟回去。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Pretty good! I went hiking on Saturday, and on Sunday I just chilled at home.
lines.zh: 還不錯！週六去爬山，週日就在家耍廢。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Nice. Where did you go hiking?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Elephant Mountain. We got there at six to catch the sunrise.
lines.zh: 象山。我們六點就到了，為了看日出。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Honestly, I was wiped out by noon. What about you? Did you do anything fun?
lines.zh: 老實說中午我就累癱了。你呢？有做什麼好玩的嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Not really. I slept in, did some laundry, and caught up on a show.
lines.zh: 沒有耶。睡到自然醒、洗了衣服，然後追了一部劇。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sounds like the perfect weekend to me.
lines.zh: 對我來說這就是完美週末啊。

dialogues.title: A friend who had a big weekend

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hey! Did you end up going to that concert?
lines.zh: 嘿！你後來有去那場演唱會嗎？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Yeah, it was amazing. We stood in the front row the whole time.
lines.zh: 有啊，超讚。我們整場都站在第一排。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No way! How did you get front-row spots?
lines.zh: 真的假的！你們怎麼搶到第一排的？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: We lined up for, like, four hours before the doors opened.
lines.zh: 開場前我們排了大概四個小時。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Four hours? I would've given up after twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 四個小時？我排二十分鐘就放棄了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Ha, it was worth it. Afterward we hung out at a bar near the venue till two.
lines.zh: 哈，很值得。結束後我們在場館附近的酒吧待到兩點。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Totally. I've already had three coffees.
lines.zh: 完全是。我已經喝三杯咖啡了。

patterns.note: 先給評價，再給一個細節

patterns.en: Not much, I just stayed in.
patterns.note: stay in = 待在家不出門

patterns.en: Did you end up going to ___?
patterns.note: end up 表示「最後結果」，問對方之前提過的計畫

patterns.en: I caught up on a show.
patterns.note: catch up on = 補做之前落後的事
回應別人的萬用句：Sounds like…

chinglish.why: 中文靠「昨天」表達過去，動詞不變。英文動詞本身要變成過去式，就算前面已經有 yesterday 也一樣。

chinglish.wrong: I didn't went to the party.
chinglish.right: I didn't go to the party.
chinglish.why: did / didn't 已經表示過去了，後面的動詞要回到原形。這是「雙重過去式」錯誤。
週末已經過了要用 was。另外 boring 講自己的週末有點負面，母語者比較常說 quiet / low-key / chill。

chinglish.right: I just relaxed at home. / I chilled at home.
chinglish.why: 中文「在家玩」直翻成 play 聽起來像小孩在玩玩具。大人的「放鬆、耍廢」用 relax / chill / hang out。

grammar.title: 過去簡單式＋不規則動詞
grammar.oneLiner: 已經結束的事，動詞要變過去式；問句和否定句用 did，動詞回到原形。
whenToUse: 描述已經結束的事件，特別是有明確時間點：yesterday, last weekend, on Saturday, two days ago。
肯定句：動詞變過去式。規則動詞加 -ed（stayed, watched），不規則動詞要記（went, got, slept, saw）。
否定句：didn't + 原形。I didn't go.
問句：Did + 主詞 + 原形？Did you go? / Where did you go?
最常用的不規則動詞：go→went, get→got, have→had, see→saw, eat→ate, sleep→slept, buy→bought, take→took, make→made, meet→met, hang out→hung out。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用時間詞（昨天、上週）或「了」「過」表達過去，動詞本身永遠不變。英文則要求動詞自己變形，而且 did 和過去式動詞只能擇一出現。台灣人最常見的兩個錯：忘了變（I go yesterday），或變兩次（I didn't went）。

examples.correct: We went to a night market on Saturday.
examples.incorrect: We go to a night market on Saturday.
examples.note: 已經發生的事，go 要變 went。

examples.correct: I didn't sleep well last night.
examples.incorrect: I didn't slept well last night.

examples.note: 問句 did 後面也是原形。

examples.correct: We hung out at a friend's place.
examples.incorrect: We hanged out at a friend's place.
examples.note: hang out 的過去式是 hung out。hanged 只用在「吊死」。

examples.correct: I bought a new jacket and met some friends for lunch.
examples.note: buy→bought、meet→met，都是常用又容易拼錯的不規則動詞。

quiz.question: I ___ (see) a really good movie last night.
Which sentence is correct?
options: I didn't went out on Sunday.
I didn't go out on Sunday.
I not went out on Sunday.

quiz.question: Where ___ you go last weekend?
quiz.explanation: 過去式的 wh- 問句用 did。

quiz.question: We ___ out at a café for hours.
I ___ (buy) this bag in Tokyo last year.

slang.meaning: 放鬆、耍廢（動詞）；很放鬆的、隨和的（形容詞）
slang.usage: 當動詞：I just chilled at home. 當形容詞：a chill weekend / He's really chill.

risk.note: 年輕人和同輩間很常用；叫別人 Chill! 或 Chill out! 有「你冷靜點」的意思，對方正在生氣時說會火上加油。

examples.en: We didn't do much, just chilled by the river.
examples.zh: 沒做什麼，就在河邊放空。

examples.en: It was a pretty chill weekend.

slang.usage: 跟朋友在一起、沒有特定目的地待著。也可以當名詞：a popular hangout（熱門聚點）。

risk.note: 用在大人之間完全自然。對剛認識的異性說 Want to hang out? 可能會被理解成約會邀請，看語境。

examples.en: We hung out at Leo's place and played board games.
examples.zh: 我們在 Leo 家待著玩桌遊。

examples.en: Do you want to hang out this weekend?
examples.zh: 這週末要不要一起出去？

slang.usage: 體力或精神消耗很大之後，比 very tired 生動很多。

examples.en: After the hike, I was completely wiped out.
Sorry, I'm going to bed. I'm wiped out.
examples.zh: 抱歉我要睡了，我累爆了。

slang.usage: 故意比平常晚起。英式也說 have a lie-in。

risk.note: 注意和 oversleep（睡過頭，不是故意的）分開。

examples.en: I slept in till eleven on Sunday.
Tomorrow's a holiday, so I'm going to sleep in.
examples.zh: 明天放假，我要睡到自然醒。

review.question: Text your friend: "I'm running late. I'm still ___ the bus."
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元：公車用 on。

review.question: Go straight and ___ a left at the temple.
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元：hang a left = 左轉。

review.question: Waiter: "Anything else?" You don't need anything. You say:
review.explanation: 複習第 2 單元：I'm good = 不用了。

review.question: A: How was your weekend? B: Pretty quiet. I ___ in and watched Netflix.
review.explanation: 已經過去的週末用過去式 stayed。

review.question: I didn't set an alarm. I just slept ___.
